title: EUNIS 2027 annual congress
institution: EUNIS (European University Information Systems), hosted by Riga Stradins University
field: Higher education information systems and digital education
about: EUNIS 2027 annual congress at Riga Stradins University, Riga, Latvia, 1-3 June 2027. Papers are submitted via EasyChair by 22 February 2027 under tracks including Learning, Teaching and Research and Governance and Policy; accepted papers appear in the EPiC Series in Computing.

upskill.name: Building an AI-Powered Education Strategy
why: track "Governance and Policy" → A010.10: "Define governance structures, professional development, adoption mechanisms, evaluation methods, responsibilities, and success frameworks for educational AI initiatives."

track "Learning, Teaching and Research" → A010.10: "Identify and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities across teaching, learning, assessment, research, student services, and educational administration."
